Milton · 2026-11-10 · City Council Meeting (City Council): Emergency Ordinance # 20-26 - Review and Fee Waivers for Hurricane Related Damages
item.description: As response efforts to Hurricane Isaias continue, planning and development have received a great deal of inquiries regarding permitting structures which legally existed before Hurricane Isaias. Typically and in line with other agencies in the state, municipalities would waive review and permitting fees associated with rebuilding hurricane-damaged, legally existing, non-altered structures for the period of the local declaration of an emergency. This ordinance allows for such fees to be waived as long as the individual seeking the waiver is building the asset back "one-for-one" in the same footprint as it existed prior to Hurricane Isaias. This ordinance would automatically repeal when the declaration of emergency ends.
